blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The tests cover core matching, filtering, Unicode ordering, determinism, health after a report, and empty input, but do not test several specified requirements such as pre-report health zeroes, one response per health input line, output replacement, canonical JSON details, or the full objective space.

deterministic_tests: Although the Python test data and assertions are deterministic, tests/test.sh performs apt-get update and downloads uv from astral.sh, so verifier execution depends on external network availability and mutable remote resources.

valid_failure_modes: A capable solution can fail for reasons unrelated to the task because the verifier requires external apt repositories and a live curl download of uv, with no local fallback or pinned immutable artifact.
advice: pinned_dependencies: The Dockerfile uses the floating python:3.13 image tag rather than an exact pinned Python image version.
